paper_title: What are they talking about Benchmarking Large Language Models for   Knowledge-Grounded Discussion Summarization
caption: Average overall performance 0.90\% of all LLMs across both KGDS patterns. The stratification is divided into three levels: Tier-1 (OP_{avg} [61, 69]), Tier-2 (OP_{avg} [53, 56]), and Tier-3 (OP_{avg} [29, 37]).
model_annotation: The bar chart displays the average performance (in percentage) of various large language models (LLMs) on knowledge-grounded discussion summarization (KGDS), with each bar representing a distinct model’s overall performance score as labeled numerically above it; the vertical y-axis is labeled “Average Performance (%)” and spans from 0 to 70 in increments of 20, while the horizontal x-axis lists no explicit model names but implies a sequence of ten distinct models based on the ten bars shown, each rendered in a unique pastel color (ranging from teal, lavender, maroon, light blue, tan, gray, pale green, to pink). The highest-performing model achieves 68.66%, followed by 66.41% and 65.77%, while the lowest is at 29.44%, with others distributed across the range. According to the caption, these performances are stratified into three tiers: Tier-1 includes models with average performance between 61% and 69% (encompassing the top three bars: 68.66, 66.41, 65.77), Tier-2 includes those between 53% and 56% (covering five bars: 55.69, 55.00, 55.30, 52.61, 55.55), and Tier-3 includes models scoring between 29% and 37% (represented by the two bars at 29.44 and 36.62). The bars are not sorted by value but appear to be grouped by tier, with Tier-1 on the left, Tier-3 in the middle, and Tier-2 on the right, suggesting a non-monotonic ordering intended to reflect the stratification rather than rank. No additional annotations, error bars, or legends are present beyond the numerical labels atop each bar.

model_annotations.English: The bar chart illustrates the average performance (in percentage) of various large language models (LLMs) on knowledge-grounded discussion summarization (KGDS), as benchmarked across two distinct KGDS patterns, with the overall performance averaged across all models reported at 0.90%. The vertical axis represents “Average Performance (%)” ranging from 0 to 70 in increments of 20, while the horizontal axis displays individual LLMs, each represented by a distinct colored bar with its exact performance value labeled above. The models are visually stratified into three tiers based on their average performance: Tier-1 includes models with performance between 61% and 69%, such as the top-performing model at 68.66% (teal bar) and others at 66.41% (mauve), 65.77% (light blue), and 62.98% (lighter blue); Tier-2 encompasses models scoring between 53% and 56%, including values such as 55.69% (lavender), 55.00% (beige), 55.30% (light gray), and 55.55% (pale pink); and Tier-3 consists of lower-performing models in the 29% to 37% range, specifically 36.62% (tan) and 29.44% (cyan). The bars are not sorted by performance but appear grouped by tier, with Tier-1 models clustered on the left, Tier-3 in the middle, and Tier-2 on the right, visually emphasizing the performance stratification described in the caption.
